summary: Build 207 converts the scattered Markdown enhancement lists into a current implementation sweep and a clean next-step backlog.
completed_this_pass: Declared AI_PROJECT_HANDOFF.md and MASTER_VALUE_ROADMAP.md as the two main living planning documents.
Added Markdown sanity admin reporting so a new chat can see which docs are canonical and which are retained history.
Added visual placeholder registry and automatic placeholder rendering for public/admin cards that need media enrichment.
Added Admin Docs/Sanity page to expose documentation, visual placeholder, SEO, and next-step status in the app.
Added dashboard diagnostics for documentation consolidation and visual placeholder readiness.
Added competitive/SEO notes from current research to the canonical roadmap.
Updated route-copy sync, release checks, schema notes, and no-DDL SQL record.

current_priority_stack.item: Turn first-pass value modules into CRUD screens
current_priority_stack.why: Quote pipeline, Meta ROI, memberships, proof-of-work, fleet, reviews, campaigns, and routing now have foundations; the next value is create/edit/save workflows.

current_priority_stack.item: Connect quote pipeline to real leads/quotes/payments
current_priority_stack.why: Revenue visibility is only useful when it reflects live quote proposal drafts, deposits, accepted/declined status, and follow-up history.

current_priority_stack.item: Add proof-of-work mobile checklist to detailer jobs
current_priority_stack.why: Required start/finish photos, condition notes, and signatures protect the business and improve professionalism.

current_priority_stack.item: Add maintenance-plan reminders from completed vehicle history
current_priority_stack.why: Repeat service is the strongest path toward predictable revenue without depending only on new leads.

current_priority_stack.item: Create visual campaign builder with placeholders and approved images
current_priority_stack.why: Seasonal offers, Meta ads, and landing pages need professional images without forcing code edits.

do_not_start_new_until: Gallery Approvals has add/edit/approve/hide paths tested live.
Quote Pipeline is connected to real quote/lead rows or clearly marked sample/fallback.
Proof-of-work checklist can be used on mobile by a detailer without opening a desktop-only admin table.
Markdown updates go to the two canonical docs first, then to historical docs only as release-check summaries.
